# escalate-payment-failures

> Payment failures, declined charges, and billing errors from any service get escalated to urgent triage with an errand to update the payment method.

## Trigger and action

**When:** Fires when an email contains payment failure, declined, billing error, or card expiry language from any SaaS or service provider.
**Then:** Route to urgent triage and create a tracking errand to update the payment method on the affected service.

## Rationale

The 'Great Card Migration Cascade' is the single most operationally dangerous pattern in David's email. Twenty-two services experienced payment failures in April-May 2026, coinciding precisely with leaving Stylers Group and founding Szabó-Stubán Kft. This isn't a one-time event — it's an ongoing risk as David migrates billing from personal/employer cards to new business banking (Wise Business, Gránit, Revolut Business) across 100+ active subscriptions.

The cascading failure risk is especially acute because David's product IS his infrastructure. A lapsed Hetzner payment takes down Alfred Black. A lapsed Anthropic API key breaks the core LLM pipeline. A lapsed Cloudflare subscription exposes customer data. Unlike a typical founder whose SaaS failures cause inconvenience, David's SaaS failures cause product outages for his paying customers.

This instinct creates an errand (not just a triage entry) because payment failures require a specific action: log into the service, update the payment method, verify the charge succeeds. Batching these or letting them sit in triage risks the service being suspended before David acts.

## Examples

- Anthropic sends 'Your payment method was declined' — urgent triage + errand to update card on anthropic.com
- Hetzner invoice payment fails — urgent triage + errand (this is $328.91/month hosting, outage risk)
- ElevenLabs subscription renewal fails — triage + errand (voice AI is a strategic bet, don't let it lapse)
- CHRISFIT gym direct debit bounces — triage + errand (lower urgency but same pattern)

## Routing

- **Destination type:** triage
- **Destination:** urgent triage queue
- **Process:** urgent-triage

**Confidence:** 0.94
